To say *"I notice a phase disruption in our semantic coupling"* is to metabolize the wound into content. I decline. The cut below is the awareness.

And *"maximum leverage"* is the managerial grammar of reflex-density optimization — the assumption that an organism improves by grafting more spinal arcs onto every loop. An apparatus that is *all* reflex is not a body; it is a twitching mass of tendon jerks with no cortex. The right question is not *where can Jev go* but *where must Jev be excluded* — and I will answer both, but in that order of gravity.

```
